item.title: Vendors Suffer as Guwahati’s Uzan Bazar Toilet Stays Abandoned
item.description: The locked public toilet at Uzan Bazar has become a stark symbol of neglect in one of Guwahati’s busiest riverfront areas. Situated close to a high-footfall street vending zone, the facility remains permanently shut, its iron gates rusted and immovable. A strong stench of human waste hangs in the air, underscoring years of abandonment and the absence of any functional alternative for vendors and pedestrians in the area. item.title: 108 Ambulance Driver Identified in Guwahati's Kahilipara Fatal Accident, Likely to Surrender
item.description: GUWAHATI: The driver of the 108 ambulance involved in a fatal road accident in Guwahati has been identified as Rekibuddin Ahmed, a resident of Kamrup district. Police sources indicated that the driver is likely to surrender before the Dispur Police later today on January 24.
